tests.name: K1. Klassi failid olemas
tests.run: for f in halb.sh inventory.ini bootstrap.yml logid/teine_jooks.txt README.md; do test -f "$f" || { echo "PUUDU: $f"; exit 1; }; done; echo OK

tests.name: K3. Päris moodulid, command/shell puudub
tests.run: grep -qE 'user:' bootstrap.yml && grep -qE 'apt:|package:|dnf:' bootstrap.yml && grep -qE 'copy:' bootstrap.yml && grep -qE 'service:|systemd:' bootstrap.yml && ! grep -qE '(command|shell):' bootstrap.yml && echo OK

tests.name: K4. Tõend: teine jooks changed=0
tests.run: grep -q 'PLAY RECAP' logid/teine_jooks.txt && grep -q 'changed=0' logid/teine_jooks.txt && echo OK

tests.name: K5. Tõend: kolm masinat, kõigil changed=0
tests.run: grep -q 'PLAY RECAP' logid/kolm_masinat.txt && test "$(grep -c 'changed=0' logid/kolm_masinat.txt)" -ge 3 && ! grep -qE 'unreachable=[1-9]|failed=[1-9]' logid/kolm_masinat.txt && echo OK

tests.name: H1. admin.yml: loop, authorized_key, changed=0
tests.run: ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini admin.yml --syntax-check >/dev/null && grep -q 'loop' admin.yml && grep -q 'authorized_key' admin.yml && grep -q 'changed=0' logid/admin_teine_jooks.txt && echo OK

tests.name: H2. hardening.yml: lineinfile, validate, handler, changed=0
tests.run: ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini hardening.yml --syntax-check >/dev/null && grep -q 'lineinfile' hardening.yml && grep -q 'validate' hardening.yml && grep -q 'handlers' hardening.yml && grep -q 'changed=0' logid/hardening_teine_jooks.txt && echo OK

tests.name: H3. baas.yml: nimekirjad, state: absent, changed=0
tests.run: ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini baas.yml --syntax-check >/dev/null && grep -q 'absent' baas.yml && grep -q 'changed=0' logid/baas_teine_jooks.txt && echo OK

tests.name: H4. raport.yml: fetch, 3 raportit
tests.run: ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini raport.yml --syntax-check >/dev/null && grep -q 'fetch' raport.yml && test "$(find raportid -type f | wc -l)" -ge 3 && echo OK

tests.name: H5–H6. cron.yml changed=0 ja drift_check olemas
tests.run: ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini cron.yml --syntax-check >/dev/null && grep -q 'cron' cron.yml && grep -q 'changed=0' logid/cron_teine_jooks.txt && test -f logid/drift_check.txt && echo OK

tests.name: I + III. markmed.md, vastused.md (≥400 sõna), oma/ playbook + README
tests.run: test -f markmed.md && test "$(wc -w < vastused.md)" -ge 400 && ls oma/*.yml >/dev/null 2>&1 && test -f oma/README.md && echo OK
